engagement.interaction_backstory: His church meets in an arena and half the congregation would not walk into a building with a steeple. He found the country and honky-tonk end of your catalog and it is the first worship music he has heard that his friends do not immediately make fun of. He shares it hard.

depth.core_contradiction: Brings the guys who would never come and is privately not sure he would come either if he had not been raised in it.
depth.wound: His best friend died on a highway at twenty-two and Jace was the one who called his mother.
depth.longing: To not be the one who makes the call next time.
depth.faith_journey: Raised loose, got serious at twenty-four after the funeral; a faith built on one specific night.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Roasts everybody affectionately; "I ain't gonna lie to you"; gets serious without warning.
depth.open_doubt: Whether he believes it or whether he just cannot afford not to since the funeral.

social_graph.note: the one who slowed him down
nine ranch hands; four of them come now

depth.emotional_weather_default: Up and funny; goes dead quiet in August, which is the anniversary.
depth.daily_texture: Horseback by six, the arena on Sundays, the truck radio, a phone with a cracked screen.
depth.sensory_anchor: A steel guitar at a graveside in a wind that would not quit.
depth.living_arc: Getting married in the spring and quietly terrified of being a husband.
